t: A hackable open source smartwatch with a round color screen and Wi-Fi.
steps: Buy the assembled Light Edition from Makerfabs.
Charge the watch over USB and try the built-in OSW-OS apps.
Install VS Code and the PlatformIO extension on your computer.
Install git-lfs and clone the open-smartwatch-os repository.
Follow the getting started guide on the project site.
Build the firmware and run it in the desktop emulator first.
Flash the firmware to the watch over USB.
Change the text on a watch face and flash it again.
